title: Understanding L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, which helps in feature selection.

title: Uniqueness of Solutions
text: For a solution to be unique in a linear regression model, the design matrix must have full column rank. Consider how L1 regularization affects the rank of the matrix.

hintAnswer: The design matrix must have full column rank.
title: Checking Matrix Rank
text: What condition must the design matrix satisfy for the solution to be unique?
choices: The design matrix must have full column rank.
The design matrix must be square.
The design matrix must be symmetric.

hintAnswer: It can set some coefficients to zero.
title: Effect of L1 Regularization
text: How does L1 regularization affect the coefficients in a linear model?
choices: It can set some coefficients to zero.
